text.p: The following are the top stories from selected Singapore newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Singapore Tourist Promotion Board and Singapore Retailers' Association will jointly launch Quality Retail Scheme which recognises top-quality retailers.
- Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto arrives in Singapore for three-day visit.
- Police Dog Unit to train police dogs to sniff out scent of criminals.
- Economists say Singapore dollar will continue to chart marginal gains against U.S. dollar this year but depreciate against yen.
- Hong Kong government may not act yet on property speculation.
- Tokyo stocks likely to continue hunt for floor.
- Sum Cheong International resumes trading after house cleaning and fundraising by new management team after a year-long suspension of trading.
- Wall Street awaits fourth-quarter corporate profit reports.
- Local electronics industry set to pick up in second half of this year.
- Sum Cheong International hopes to list company on Singapore stock exchange once group is on stronger foundation.
